newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern hopeful about CSX, Conrail.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern hopeful about CSX, Conrail.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp on Monday said it was hopeful that Conrail Inc and CSX Corp would quickly reach a definitive agreement concerning their proposed merger.

Norfolk Southern said in a statement that it hoped the agreement would "permit CSX and Norfolk Southern work out a plan to restructure the rail transportation system in the East into combined Conrail/Norfolk Southern and Conrail/CSX systems."
Norfolk Southern's statement came in response to developments on Monday in which Conrail said it would negotiate amendments to its planned merger with CSX.
